title: Header new-tab and options glyphs grow, 5.5:1 to 11.3:1 contrast
caption: 5.9.0 drew the options caret at 5x4 px and the new-tab + at 7x7 px on a (65,72,104) chip, at 5.5:1. 6.0.0 draws the caret at 8x8 px and the + at 12x12 px on the header, at 11.3:1.
objective_basis: Old caret x1241-1245, y42-45, (192,202,245) on (65,72,104) = 5.53:1; old + x1263-1269, y41-47, (191,201,244) = 5.48:1. New (9d1e754e9): + x1222-1233, y11-22; caret x1254-1261, y12-19; both (192,202,245) on (20,21,29) = 11.26:1. The header also gains a 14x14 px settings gear at x1181-1194 in the same colour, and a 1 px divider at x1244 between + and the caret.

title: A new window's first prompt is on row 1, not row 2
caption: In every freshly launched 5.9.0 window the first row was empty and the prompt sat on row 2. In 6.0.0 the prompt is on row 1. With the shorter header, the first prompt moves from y 80 to y 44.
objective_basis: Prompt glyph bounding box on (52,55,65): old x8-147, y80-95 (row 2; row 1 glyph tops are y64-66 in C02-focused, C21-bidi and C23-escape-suite, pitch about 16.2 px); y58-79 holds no text. The same row-2 prompt (top y80) is in old C13-marks, C21-es-window, C24-bad-config-0 and C19-after-restart, each a fresh launch per receipts.jsonl. Final candidate: prompt x12-149, y44-59 (row 1) here and in C13-marks, C21-es-window and C24-bad-config-0; the frame differs from r14 only in the header and the blinking cursor.

title: Window chrome shrinks from 58 px to 32 px
caption: 5.9.0 drew the native 32 px title bar, then a separate 23 px tab strip and an accent line, 58 px in all, plus a 1 px accent frame round the window. 6.0.0 puts the traffic lights, the tab, and the settings, new-tab and options controls in one 32 px header, so the terminal starts 26 px higher.
objective_basis: Old, vertical run at x=300: y0-31 title bar (41,41,42), y32 line (42,43,53), y33-55 tab strip (26,27,38), y56 accent (118,157,235), y57 blend, terminal (52,55,65) from y58; 1 px accent (122,162,247) at x=1279 and y=819. New (9d1e754e9): header (20,21,29) y0-31 at x=1150; the one tab spans x77-1111 in the terminal colour (52,55,65) under a (122,162,247) top line (y0-2 at x=300); terminal from y32; no frame (x=1279 and y=819 are terminal background). Header controls: settings gear x1181-1194, + x1222-1233, options caret x1254-1261. C23-ucs.yaml gives the grid as 162x46 in 5.9.0 and 161x47 in 6.0.0 for the same 1280x820 window.

title: An unfocused window keeps a hollow cursor at the prompt
caption: With another window in front, 5.9.0 drew no cursor. 6.0.0 draws a steady 8x16 px hollow outline, so the typing position stays visible.
objective_basis: Old C02-focused: 8x16 block (192,202,245) at x156-163, y714-729; old C02-unfocused: none of that colour in x150-175, y711-734. 5.9.0 source e58e367b9 crates/kettle-render/src/terminal.rs:830 reads 'Cursor: hidden with the window unfocused', so this is not blink phase. The same holds in C09-unfocused-selection-and-cursor: no cursor in 5.9.0, a hollow outline in 6.0.0. Final candidate (9d1e754e9): the C02-unfocused crop is pixel-identical to r14's; the outline is x160-167, y694-709 (44 px of (192,202,245)). Its C02-focused frame caught the cursor's blink-off phase, so the cell is located from the outline itself. C09-unfocused-selection-and-cursor shows the same outline at the same cell.

title: A zoomed pane says it is zoomed, how many panes hide, and how to restore
caption: After the same zoom of a 3-pane tab, 5.9.0 showed the pane with no title strip and no sign that 2 panes were hidden. 6.0.0 keeps a strip that reads 'Zoomed · 2 panes hidden', the restore shortcut, the title and the size.
objective_basis: Receipts: both runs pressed ctrl+shift+x (action=zoom) after split_right and split_down. New: accent strip (122,162,247) x0-1279, y33-52, text '⤢ Zoomed · 2 panes hidden · ⌃⇧X restores  fixture  161x45' (x~14-465). Old: tab strip ends at y57 and the terminal starts at y58 with no strip; the only title on screen is the tab's '1: fixture'. Final candidate: the strip (x1-1278, y33-53, text x0-463) is pixel-identical to r14's; only the header differs.

title: Palette highlights the characters that match the query
caption: With 'split' typed, 5.9.0 drew every result label in plain text. 6.0.0 colours the matching characters, such as 'Split' and 'splits', in the accent blue, at 6.79:1 on the list background.
objective_basis: Pure accent (122,162,247) pixels in the unselected result rows: new 116, at x311-404, y162-284 ('Split' on rows 2-5, 22 px each; 'splits' on row 6, 28 px), (122,162,247) on (26,27,38) = 6.79:1; the selected row's 'Split' is (163,191,249) on the selection fill (59,77,119), 4.53:1. Old: 0 in the result list x440-700, y612-780, where labels such as 'Split up' are (192,202,245) throughout. Same query typed in both runs (receipts).

title: Settings adds a reset key and a Reset button
caption: 5.9.0's footer listed field, change, ends, category and close, with no reset key. 6.0.0's key list, now in the sidebar, includes 'Del reset', and the highlighted row shows a Reset button beside its value, dimmed while the value is already the default.
objective_basis: Old footer x344-872, y562-577: '↑↓/jk field  ↔/hl change  g/G ends  Tab category  Esc close'. New (9d1e754e9) sidebar key list x191-283, y441-533, one key per line: '↑↓/jk field', '↔/hl change', 'g/G ends', 'Del reset' (y492-501), 'Tab category', 'Esc close'; keys (192,202,245) 10.59:1, actions (156,165,201) 7.03:1 on (26,27,38). The highlighted Appearance row carries a 'Reset' chip x877-936, y141-168 beside '‹ Follow system ›', its text (126,131,151), 4.54:1. CHANGELOG 6.0.0: 'Delete or Backspace resets the highlighted setting to its default'.

title: Settings values are drawn as controls: choice arrows, fields and switches
caption: 5.9.0 printed every value as plain text in one column ('On', 'Block', '13 pt'). 6.0.0 draws choices between ‹ › arrows, numbers in boxed fields and on/off settings as switches.
objective_basis: New Appearance page, first screen: 5 choice controls with ‹ › (Appearance, Theme, Minimum contrast, Cursor shape, Unfocused cursor), 3 value wells filled (57,60,76) (Font size 13 px, Background opacity 86%, Window padding 12 px) and 2 accent (122,162,247) switches (Window blur y423-448, Show pane titlebars y524-549); the controls span x866-1088, y141-680. Cursor blink and Stop blinking after are below this first screen in 6.0.0. Old: 9 values as unboxed text in one column, no control glyphs.

title: Box-drawing lines are single 1 px strokes with no soft edge
caption: 5.9.0 drew box-drawing characters from the font: each line was a bright pixel plus a half-bright one, so the two boxes held 75 colours. 6.0.0 draws them itself as 1 px lines in one colour.
objective_basis: Two boxes on the background (52,55,65). Old x11-139, y215-251: 75 distinct colours; left stroke (179,188,227) at x11 and (166,174,209) at x12, then (86,91,107) at x13-14; top stroke (86,91,107) at y217 above (192,202,245) at y218. New x15-125, y182-215: 2 colours; left stroke one pixel (192,202,245) at x15 with background beside it. Final candidate: the two boxes (x15-125, y182-215) are pixel-identical to r14's; the crop changes only in the emoji row below them.

title: Skin-tone and ZWJ emoji draw as one glyph, and VS16 emoji in colour
caption: The same emoji line was printed in both runs. 5.9.0 split the skin-toned thumbs-up into a thumb and a skin swatch, the woman technologist into a woman and a laptop, and the family into three faces, and drew the red heart and smiling face as monochrome text glyphs. 6.0.0 draws each sequence as one glyph and the heart and smiling face in colour.
objective_basis: Fixture line (panel/fixture/torture.sh): 'Emoji: 😀 👍🏽 👩‍💻 👨‍👩‍👧 🏳️‍🌈 🇯🇵 🇪🇸 ❤️ ☺️ ⌚ 🫖'. Old row y~270-288: thumb x~86-99 plus a separate skin swatch x~102-114, woman x~125-134 plus laptop x~140-154, three faces x~164-197; heart x~297-304 and smiling face x~311-320 in the text colour only (0 saturated pixels). New row y240-253, segmented by blank columns: 11 glyphs for 11 emoji, each 10-14 px wide: toned thumb x90-103, technologist x115-126, family x137-150 (a grey silhouette, as Apple draws it), red heart x231-244 (119 px with channel spread over 80), colour smiling face x254-267 (134). Flags render as flags in both builds.

title: A hovered link shows its destination and how to open it
caption: Both drags end with the pointer on a URL. 5.9.0 shows nothing more. 6.0.0 shows a status pill at the bottom left with the URL, https://example.org/docs/page18, and the hint to Cmd+click it.
objective_basis: Drag end (30%,40%) = window point (384,328). Old: row y324-338 is page17, URL span x250-492, so the pointer is on a URL; x0-700, y740-815 holds only background and the window edge. New: pill fill (26,27,38) x1-393 from y804 to the window's bottom edge, text 'https://example.org/docs/page18 | ⌘-click to open' x15-386, y806-818 in (192,202,245), 10.59:1. The pill is pixel-identical to r14's; unlike r14, this frame draws no underline under the hovered URL, so the caption no longer claims one. The pill was added after 5.9.0 (commit 6436c1f7d, 'show where a hovered link goes').

title: Option-drag selects a rectangle
caption: The same Option-drag from 10%,20% to 30%,40% of the window made an ordinary stream selection in 5.9.0: from mid-row to the right edge, full rows, then the start of the last row. 6.0.0 selects an 11-row by 33-column block, as Terminal.app does.
objective_basis: Selection fill extent per row. Old (40,52,87): first row x125-1271 (y162-177), middle rows x8-1271, last row x8-381 (y324-338). New: fill (67,86,145) inside a 1 px (112,131,189) outline, x129-385 on every row, y158-336. Receipts log the same drag with mods 'alt' in both runs. Commit 36b5ba232 ('select a block with Option-drag on macOS') explains the old result: selection read modifiers that hide Option unless macos-option-as-alt maps it.

title: Selection fill rises from 1.03:1 to 1.68:1, with a 3.21:1 outline
caption: macOS windows are translucent by default and the selection fill is opaque. 5.9.0's fill (#283457) was darker than the see-through background and nearly the same luminance, 1.03:1. 6.0.0's (#435691) measures 1.68:1 against the same captured background and is outlined by a 1 px edge at 3.21:1 (as captured at the default 86% window opacity).
objective_basis: Captured background (52,55,65) in both builds (sampled at x900 y100, x1100 y700, x640 y780; identical). Fill: old (40,52,87) = 1.03:1, no edge; new (67,86,145) = 1.68:1, its 1 px outline (112,131,189) = 3.21:1 against the background (selection x12-1267, y158-287). Against the theme's opaque (26,27,38) the fills are 1.40:1 and 2.42:1. Same fill and outline in C09-block-selected. r14 (a8dd0f66a) had a brighter (77,100,166) fill at 2.09:1 and no outline.

title: An unfocused window's selection turns grey, with its own outline
caption: With another window in front, 5.9.0 kept its focused fill, 1.03:1 against the captured background. 6.0.0 switches to a neutral grey fill at 1.28:1 with a 1 px grey outline at 2.16:1, distinct from its blue focused fill. (As captured at the default 86% window opacity.)
objective_basis: Unfocused selection fill: old (40,52,87), the same as its focused fill; new (71,71,71) inside a 1 px (105,105,105) outline (x12-1267, y158-254), against the background (52,55,65): 1.28:1 and 2.16:1; against the theme's opaque (26,27,38): 1.84:1 and 3.11:1. New focused fill (C09-shift-extended): (67,86,145) with a (112,131,189) outline. Receipts log backdrop mode 'front' before both captures. r14 (a8dd0f66a) used a blue (60,75,122) unfocused fill at 1.40:1.

title: Other search matches rise from 1.03:1 to 2.59:1 contrast
caption: 5.9.0 filled the non-current matches with #283457, 1.03:1 against the captured background: they read as plain text. 6.0.0 fills them with #5d73b4, 2.59:1. The current match keeps the same amber fill. (As captured at the default 86% window opacity.)

title: Search shows the current match and total
caption: 5.9.0's search bar showed no match count. 6.0.0 shows the current match and the total, 35/122, next to the query.
objective_basis: New text '35/122' at x328-373, y799-812, (192,202,245) on the bar's (64,71,103), 5.62:1. Old bar: query field x70-561, then Prev, Next, Wrap, Case, Enter: Next and Close; no count anywhere in y796-814. Final candidate: the search bar is pixel-identical to r14's (the earlier 5.53:1 used the theme's (65,72,104) rather than the captured bar); only the scroll bar beside it differs.

title: Search bar gains a Regex toggle beside Case
caption: The 5.9.0 search bar offered Prev, Next, Wrap and Case. 6.0.0 adds a 'Regex: On' toggle between Case and Enter: Next.
objective_basis: New controls, x: Prev 485-529, Next 555-598, Wrap 628-689, Case 714-798 (+ arrow 817-820), Regex: On 843-911, Enter: Next 941-1024. Old: Prev 587-631, Next 656-700, Wrap 729-790, Case 816-899 (+ arrow 918-922), Enter: Next 941-1024; no Regex control. Final candidate: the search bar is pixel-identical to r14's; only the scroll bar above it differs.

title: A scrolled-up pane shows a '360 lines' button back to the bottom
caption: After the same single wheel step, 5.9.0 showed nothing about the offset. 6.0.0 shows a button at the bottom right with a Down arrow, '360 lines' and its shortcut, Ctrl+End.
objective_basis: Receipts: one wheel event at (0.5,0.5) in both. New button x1124-1265, y792-813: 1 px border (146,148,158), fill (102,103,108), '↓ 360 lines' and '⌃End' with text peaking at (227,231,250), 4.59:1, split by a divider. Old: x1150-1268, y770-815 is background only. Last visible line 99641 in both frames.

title: Hint mode shows a help line with its keys
caption: In hint mode, 5.9.0 showed only the labels. 6.0.0 adds a bottom line: 'Label: copy text / open URL · Shift+label: copy text · Esc to cancel'.
objective_basis: New text x0-535, y804-818, (192,202,245) on (26,27,38), 10.59:1. Old: no pixel in x20-1250, y790-816 differs from the background by more than 30.

title: Hint labels no longer cover URL text
caption: 5.9.0 drew every quick-select label as two letters over the start of its URL, hiding 'ht' on all 40 rows. 6.0.0 puts the URL labels in blank cells: two-letter labels after the URL (rows 1-16), one-letter labels in the space before it (rows 17-40).
objective_basis: Read at 2.5x zoom. Old: amber (224,175,104) label cells at x~250-265 on every URL row (y64-729), over the URL's first two letters. New: rows 1-16 carry two-letter labels after the URL end (x~494-510), rows 17-40 a single letter in the blank cell before 'https' (x~246-252); the URL text is fully visible on every row. The prompt's label still covers one character in 6.0.0 ('~' under 'a'; 5.9.0 covered '~/' with 'sy').

title: Background-tab activity dot sits by the title, 259 px to 4 px
caption: While a command ran in background tab 1, 5.9.0 drew its activity mark at the tab's left edge, 259 px from the title. 6.0.0 draws the dot 4 px before the title, and its contrast with the surrounding fill rises from 5.21:1 to 10.60:1.
objective_basis: Old: mark (125,207,255) x6-14, y44-51 on the tab fill (65,72,104), 5.21:1; title '1: fixture' starts at x274. New: 8x8 px dot x279-286, y12-19 on (20,21,29), 10.60:1; the title's leftmost ink at x291, a 4 px gap.

title: Finished commands leave a red or green exit tick at the right edge
caption: After true, false and ls, 5.9.0 drew nothing at the right edge. 6.0.0 draws a red tick for false (exit 1) and a green tick for ls. The first command, true, got no tick.
objective_basis: New: (247,118,142) at x1272-1277, y55-58 and (158,206,106) at x1272-1277, y73-74. The ticks sit on a track scaled to the grid, not on the text rows; in C13-new-tab-cwd a row-1 'pwd' puts its green tick at x1272-1277, y39-40, which maps red to 'false' (row 2) and green to 'ls' (row 3). Old: no pixel other than background (52,55,65) in x1240-1278, y58-800. Final candidate: the ticks are unchanged (red 24 px at x1272-1277, y55-58; green 12 px at y73-74); the crop differs from r14 only in the header and the cursor.

title: Inactive tab titles go from 5.53:1 to 7.05:1 contrast
caption: 5.9.0 drew the inactive tab title on a raised (65,72,104) fill at 5.53:1. 6.0.0 draws it on the header background at 7.05:1, above the 7:1 AAA level.
objective_basis: Old inactive title (192,202,245) on (65,72,104) = 5.53:1. New inactive title x285-338, y9-19, peak (152,160,194) on (20,21,29) = 7.05:1. The header sits outside the translucent terminal area in both builds.

title: Tabs show their Cmd+1 and Cmd+2 shortcuts
caption: 5.9.0's tabs showed an index and the title ('1: fixture'). 6.0.0 shows the title and each tab's go-to-tab key, Cmd+1 and Cmd+2, written with the macOS command symbol.
objective_basis: New hint text '⌘1' x547-561, y10-19, peak (121,126,146) on (20,21,29) = 4.51:1; '⌘2' x1064-1079 on the active tab, peak (170,174,187), 5.36:1 on the captured tab (52,55,65). Old tabs hold '1: fixture' (x274-349) and '2: fixture' (x889-965) and a close box, no other text. Same hints in new C13-long-command-background.

title: Background-tab bell mark sits by the title, 234 px to 4 px
caption: When background tab 2 rang the bell, 5.9.0 drew its mark at the tab's left edge, 234 px from the title. 6.0.0 draws an 11x11 px bell glyph 4 px before the title, and its contrast with the surrounding fill rises from 4.47:1 to 9.09:1.
objective_basis: Old: mark (224,175,104) x646-654, y44-51 on the tab fill (65,72,104), 4.47:1; title '2: fixture' starts at x889. New: bell glyph (224,175,104) x795-805, y11-21 on (20,21,29), 9.09:1; the title's leftmost ink at x810, a 4 px gap. r14 drew a 6x6 px dot here.

title: The right-click menu on a link fits without scrolling
caption: On a link, 5.9.0's menu showed 22 of its 24 rows with a scroll arrow at the bottom; Settings… and Preferences were out of view. 6.0.0's link menu has 16 rows, all visible, with Open Link and Copy Link Address first.
objective_basis: Old menu border x321-576, y74-781; scroll arrow (122,162,247) x443-454, y770-775; last visible row 'Theme…'. Old C16-context-menu-empty lists Theme…, Settings… and Preferences at the end, so 2 rows were hidden. New (9d1e754e9) border x320-538, y348-815 (window bottom y819); rows Open Link (highlighted), Copy Link Address, Copy, Paste, Select All, Quick-select hints, Find…, Clear Scrollback and 8 submenus (Split, Pane, Tab, Window, Title, Group, Broadcast Input, Appearance).

title: Shift+right-click over vim starts the menu with a line on the Shift gestures
caption: Over vim with its mouse mode on, Shift+right-click opens Kettle's menu in both builds. 5.9.0's starts with Paste. 6.0.0's starts with 'Shift+drag selects. Shift+right-click opens the menu.', which says how the menu was reached.
objective_basis: New (9d1e754e9): one line x145-556, y213-226 at the top of the menu (border from x128, y205), (156,165,201) on (26,27,38), 7.03:1. Old: first row 'Paste' x145-369, y147-156. The same line appears in new C16-tui-override-menu-on-selection. r14 (a8dd0f66a) showed a four-line 'Hold Shift to select text or open the menu while a program uses the mouse' at 4.54:1.

title: Relaunch restores the previous output and directory
caption: After Cmd+Q and relaunch with each build's default restore setting, 5.9.0 opened a fresh prompt in ~/project and Shift+Page Up showed nothing earlier. 6.0.0 reopens in ~/project/src, where the session was left, and Shift+Page Up shows the earlier command and its output, dimmed, above a 'Restored' divider. Per the CHANGELOG, 6.0.0's default (auto) restores on macOS when 'Close windows when quitting an application' is off, and this capture restored; 5.9.0 restored only with restore-session = true.
objective_basis: The harness drops the panel's pinned restore-session = false for this task, so each build runs its default (5.9.0 e58e367b9 crates/kettle-config/src/lib.rs:3082 restore_session: false). Old after Shift+Page Up: only 'fixture:~/project$' (x8-163, y80-96). New: 'cd src && printf ...', 'restore-marker alpha', 'restore-marker beta' and the old prompt at y44-108, dimmed to (109,115,142); 'Restored · <date time>' y112-121; live prompt 'fixture:~/project/src$' y125-140. C19-before-restart ends at 'fixture:~/project/src$' in both runs. Final candidate: same rows as r14; only the divider's time and the cursor differ.

title: The tab strip and scrollback are in the macOS accessibility tree
caption: In 5.9.0 the window's accessibility tree held the terminal text area and the system window buttons. 6.0.0 adds a 'Tabs' tab group with a selected 'fixture' tab, a 'Tab bar controls' toolbar with 'Settings', 'New Tab' and a 'New Tab Options' pop-up button, and a 'Scrollback' scroll bar, so VoiceOver can reach them.
objective_basis: C20-ax-tree.json. Old: AXWindow > AXGroup > AXTextArea 'fixture', plus the close, minimize and full-screen buttons and an AXStaticText 'fixture' (the title), which 6.0.0 no longer exposes. New (9d1e754e9): AXGroup holds AXTabGroup 'Tabs' {AXRadioButton/AXTabButton 'fixture' value=true}, AXToolbar 'Tab bar controls' {AXButton 'Settings' (help 'Command comma'), AXButton 'New Tab' (help 'Command T'), AXPopUpButton 'New Tab Options'} and AXTextArea 'fixture' with child AXScrollBar 'Scrollback'. On screen: the tab x77-1111, the gear, + and caret x1181-1261.

title: Hebrew and Arabic display right to left
caption: 5.9.0 drew right-to-left text in stored order from left to right, so the first letter of the Hebrew phrase (shin) sat at its left end. 6.0.0 draws Unicode bidi display order: shin is at the right end, final mem at the left, and the Arabic lines reorder the same way.
objective_basis: The fixture stores 'שלום עולם' (SHIN LAMED VAV FINAL-MEM / AYIN VAV LAMED FINAL-MEM) after 'Latin first: ' (13 cells). Leftmost Hebrew cell: old x~109-116, y64-77 is shin (three prongs); new x~113-120, y44-57 is final mem (closed box), with shin rightmost. The same reversal shows in the Urdu and Yiddish rows of C23-ucs-detect. Final candidate: the Hebrew line is pixel-identical to r14's; the Arabic lines are shaped differently glyph by glyph but keep right-to-left order.

title: Context menu adds Copiar, Seleccionar todo and Buscar, and shrinks from 22 rows to 14
caption: With nothing selected, 5.9.0's Spanish context menu had 22 rows, ran to 3 px above the window's bottom edge, and had no Copiar, Seleccionar todo or Buscar. 6.0.0 lists Copiar (disabled with nothing selected), Pegar, Seleccionar todo, Selección rápida, Buscar and Borrar el historial first and groups the rest into 8 submenus: 14 rows, 403 px tall.
objective_basis: Rows read from the frames. Old: Pegar … Preferencias, 22 rows; menu x27-353, border y138-815 (window bottom y819). New (9d1e754e9): 14 rows; border x26-361, y369-771; Copiar (126,131,151), 4.54:1; Pegar opens highlighted in (59,77,119). Submenu rows: Dividir, Panel, Pestaña, Ventana, Título, Grupo, Enviar la entrada a varios paneles, Apariencia.

title: Font size is shown in px, its real unit, not pt
caption: 5.9.0's Settings showed the font size as '13 pt', though font-size is measured in logical pixels. 6.0.0 shows '13 px' and describes it as 'Ajustar el tamaño de la fuente de la terminal en píxeles lógicos.' The macOS default stays 13.
objective_basis: Old value text '13 pt' at x605-642, y365-377. New value well x1006-1088, y293-320, text '13 px' x1029-1065, y301-313, and description x437-940, y324-337. CHANGELOG 6.0.0: 'Settings and --check-config label font sizes in logical px.'

title: Menu shortcuts: macOS symbols, 4.54:1 to 7.03:1
caption: 5.9.0 spelled shortcuts out in mixed order ('Cmd+V', 'Shift+Cmd+D', 'Ctrl+Shift+A') at 4.54:1. 6.0.0 writes them with the macOS modifier symbols, as the system menu bar does, at 7.03:1. The command palette changed the same way, for example 'Cmd+W' became the command symbol and W.
objective_basis: Hint text vs the menu background (26,27,38): old (126,131,151) = 4.54:1 ('Cmd+V', 'Ctrl+Shift+A', 'Shift+Cmd+D', 'Cmd+,'). New (9d1e754e9): enabled unselected rows (156,165,201) = 7.03:1 ('⌘A' x330-345, y434-443, '⌃⇧H', '⌘F', '⌘K'); 'Pegar' opens highlighted, its '⌘V' (192,202,245) on (59,77,119) = 5.17:1; disabled Copiar's '⌘C' peaks at (125,130,150), 4.48:1. C21-es-palette: old 'Cmd+T', 'Cmd+W', 'Ctrl+PageDown' at 4.54:1; new '⌘W' at 7.03:1, and Pestaña siguiente now lists '⇧⌘]'. Old orders modifiers both Shift-before-Cmd and Ctrl-before-Shift.

title: Palette query moves from 369 px to 60 px from the results
caption: In 5.9.0 the command palette's query caret sat in a full-width bar at the window's bottom-left corner, 369 px from the first result. In 6.0.0 the query is the top row of the results card, 60 px from the first result under a 'Pestañas' heading, and its hint adds the Tab and arrow keys for selecting.
objective_basis: Caret to the first result's text, centre to centre vertically and to the text's start horizontally. Old: caret x33, y796-816 in a bar spanning y794-819 and the full width; first result text x333-431, y585-598; distance √(300²+215²) ≈ 369 px. New (9d1e754e9): caret x315, y97-122 inside the card (x282-997, y95-463), placeholder 'Escribir un comando…' and hint '(Enter ejecutar · Tab/↑↓ seleccionar · Esc cancelar)' in (156,165,201), 7.03:1; heading 'Pestañas' y133-143; first result 'Nueva pestaña' text from x299, y161-174 on the selected row; distance √(16²+58²) ≈ 60 px.

title: Spanish Settings adds a search field, categories and per-row help
caption: 5.9.0's Spanish Settings showed a label and a value per row under 8 category tabs. 6.0.0 adds a 'Buscar configuración' field, 11 categories in a sidebar, and a Spanish sentence under each of the 10 rows on the Apariencia page's first screen, at 7.03:1.
objective_basis: Frame text. Old panel x240-1039, y255-599: 8 tabs (Apariencia … Atajos) at y297-310, 9 rows with a label and a value, no input field. New panel (9d1e754e9) x179-1100, y66-753: field 'Buscar configuración' x191-406, y78-105; sidebar x192-405, y118-421 with 11 categories (adds Texto / Renderizado, Sesiones, Terminal rápida) and the key list below it; 10 rows under three headings (Colores y texto, Ventana, Cursor), each with a description line, such as 'Ajustar el tamaño de la fuente de la terminal en píxeles lógicos.' (boxed, x437-940, y324-337), in (156,165,201) on (26,27,38) = 7.03:1. r14 (a8dd0f66a) drew the descriptions in (126,131,151), 4.54:1, and listed 11 rows.

title: SGR 53 overline is drawn
caption: In the escape suite's SGR line, 'over' (SGR 53) had no line above it in 5.9.0. 6.0.0 draws a 1 px overline across it, so all seven styles on the line render as named.
objective_basis: Old: no pixel with luminance > 0.3 in x360-410, y58-68, above the 'over' glyphs at y69-76. New: 31 px of (192,202,245) at y44, x371-401, above the glyphs at y49-56.

title: Bad config shows a notice with file, line and allowed range
caption: With an out-of-range font-size and an unknown key in the config, 5.9.0 showed nothing in the window. 6.0.0 shows 'Config settings ignored' naming config:4 (expects 5 to 72) and config:5 (unknown setting), with Open Config and Dismiss buttons, and it was still there 7.1 s later.
objective_basis: New frame text 'Config settings ignored:', 'config:4 font-size: expects a number from 5 to 72', 'config:5 not-a-key: unknown setting', buttons 'Open Config' and 'Dismiss' (notice x260-1019, y36-120). Old: x200-1100, y58-160 holds only background. C24-bad-config-late-0 was captured 7.1 s after the first frame in both runs (receipts) and shows the same notice in 6.0.0 and nothing in 5.9.0. Final candidate: the notice (x260-1019, y34-120) is pixel-identical to r14's; only the header and the cursor differ.
